basic_profile.bio: I'm a 37-year-old outdoor enthusiast living in Colorado, originally from Vermont. As a professional mountain guide, I have a deep passion for alpinism and spend most of my free time planning and embarking on climbing expeditions. I also enjoy gaming, particularly competitive games like Brawl Stars. I tend to browse Reddit during the evenings, after a day of outdoor activities, or during downtime on expeditions. I'm in a long-term relationship with my partner, who shares my love for the mountains. I dislike overly commercialized experiences and prefer authentic, nature-centric adventures.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have extensive knowledge in alpine climbing, gained through years of professional guiding and personal expeditions. My expertise is complemented by a degree in Outdoor Education and certifications in wilderness first aid and avalanche safety. Additionally, I have a good grasp of competitive gaming strategies, particularly in mobile games, through years of self-study and participating in online communities.
